comparison.objective: Mount a terminal block, versus fracture and recover HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Aligning and latching a block onto a rail or mount rather than coaxial mandrel placement, hammering, and tiny-fragment handling.
comparison.success_condition: Terminal block mounted; seating, orientation, and retention thresholds are absent. Candidate requires four contact-loaded fractures with no coil or shell damage.
comparison.reason: Although both concern installed hardware, latching a terminal block tests assembly rather than controlled sacrificial-tang fracture and containment.
